author: Alex2kk
quote: Just wrapped up Chapter 2 of GTA 6, and yeah… it still doesn’t improve. Ignore the people claiming “it only gets good after Chapter 1.” That’s not true. Chapter 2 feels even slower and more tedious in places, and story-wise it’s basically filler. You’re stuck as Lucia running around doing random side stuff that has zero connection to the actual plot. The game just isn’t particularly enjoyable.
